episodes.title: Introduction to Anatomy & Physiology
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course, Hank introduces you to the complex history and terminology of Anatomy & Physiology.

episodes.title: Tissues, Part 1
episodes.description: Explore the history of histology and the varieties and roles of tissues in the human body.

episodes.title: Tissues, Part 2 – Epithelial Tissue
episodes.description: Hank examines the structures and jobs of epithelial tissue.

episodes.title: Tissues, Part 3 – Connective Tissues
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Anatomy & Physiology, Hank Green continues our exploration of tissues, with an introduction to your connective tissues.

episodes.title: Tissues, Part 4 – Types of Connective Tissues
episodes.description: Compare connective tissue types and learn why some are easier to damage than others.

episodes.title: The Integumentary System, Part 1 – Skin Deep
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Anatomy & Physiology, Hank Green teaches you about your body's biggest organ - your skin.

episodes.title: The Integumentary System, Part 2 – Skin Deeper
episodes.description: Explore how the integumentary system protects the body and connects it with the surrounding world.

episodes.title: The Nervous System, Part 1
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Anatomy & Physiology, Hank kicks off our look around MISSION CONTROL: the nervous system.

episodes.title: The Nervous System, Part 2 – Action! Potential!
episodes.description: Explore how ion channels and electrical changes in neurons generate the action potentials that carry nervous-system signals.

episodes.title: The Nervous System, Part 3 – Synapses!
episodes.description: Hank Green continues our tour of the nervous system with a look at synapses and the stuff cocaine does to your body.

episodes.title: Central Nervous System
episodes.description: In this episode, we'll explore how your brain develops and how important location is for each of your brain's many functions.

episodes.title: Peripheral Nervous System
episodes.description: Examine peripheral nerves, sensory and motor divisions, reflex arcs, and how the brain interprets pain.

episodes.title: Autonomic Nervous System
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Anatomy & Physiology, Hank Green takes you on a tour of your two-part autonomic nervous system.

episodes.title: Sympathetic Nervous System
episodes.description: Hank explains sympathetic nervous system functions and the terminology used to describe them.

episodes.title: Parasympathetic Nervous System
episodes.description: Explore the parasympathetic nervous system’s role in resting and digestion, with mnemonic aids for learning its anatomy.

episodes.title: Taste & Smell
episodes.description: Learn how chemoreceptors translate chemical stimuli into the senses of taste and smell.

episodes.title: Hearing & Balance
episodes.description: Hank Green continues the journey through sensory systems with a look at how your sense of hearing works.

episodes.title: Vision
episodes.description: Explore eye anatomy, how vision works, and how optical illusions can trick visual perception.

episodes.title: The Skeletal System
episodes.description: Hank explains the skeletal system and why astronauts Scott Kelly and Mikhail Kornienko are out in space studying it.

episodes.title: Joints
episodes.description: Compare the axial and appendicular skeleton and explore joint classifications and the movements joints enable.

episodes.title: Muscles, Part 1 – Muscle Cells
episodes.description: We're kicking off our exploration of muscles with a look at the complex and important relationship between actin and myosin.

episodes.title: Muscles, Part 2 – Organismal Level
episodes.description: Hank calls in a friend to do his push-ups for him today to explain how skeletal muscles work together to create and reverse movements.

episodes.title: Endocrine System, Part 1 – Glands & Hormones
episodes.description: Hank begins teaching you about your endocrine system by explaining how it uses glands to produce hormones.

episodes.title: Endocrine System, Part 2 – Hormone Cascades
episodes.description: In the second half of our look at the endocrine system, Hank discusses chemical homeostasis and hormone cascades.

episodes.title: The Heart, Part 1 – Under Pressure
episodes.description: Explore how the heart’s chambers and valves circulate blood and what systolic and diastolic blood pressure measurements mean.

episodes.title: The Heart, Part 2 – Heart Throbs
episodes.description: Trace the heart’s electrical conduction system and learn how pacemaker cells and defibrillators affect its rhythm.

episodes.title: Blood Vessels, Part 1 – Form and Function
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Anatomy & Physiology, Hank explains your blood vessels and their basic three-layer structure.

episodes.title: Blood Vessels, Part 2
episodes.description: Learn how blood pressure works, what elevated pressure means, and how it affects health.

episodes.title: Blood, Part 1 – True Blood
episodes.description: Explore blood cells, platelets, plasma, clotting, and how antigens determine blood type.

episodes.title: Blood, Part 2 – There Will Be Blood
episodes.description: Explore red blood cells and hemoglobin, then examine how blood doping works and why it is dangerous.

episodes.title: Respiratory System, Part 1
episodes.description: Explore respiratory anatomy and the diffusion and bulk flow processes that make breathing possible.

episodes.title: Respiratory System, Part 2
episodes.description: In part 2 of our look at your respiratory system, Hank explains how your blood cells exchange oxygen and CO2 to maintain homeostasis.

episodes.title: Digestive System, Part 1
episodes.description: Follow food through the digestive system, from ingestion and breakdown to nutrient absorption and elimination.

episodes.title: Digestive System, Part 2
episodes.description: Explore mechanical and chemical digestion in the mouth and stomach and the phases that regulate stomach activity.

episodes.title: Digestive System, Part 3
episodes.description: Follow chemical digestion through the small intestine and examine contributions from the liver, gallbladder, pancreas, and large intestine.

episodes.title: Metabolism & Nutrition, Part 1
episodes.description: Explore essential nutrients and compare the energy demands of anabolic and catabolic reactions.

episodes.title: Metabolism & Nutrition, Part 2
episodes.description: Explore cellular respiration, ATP, glycogenesis, and insulin’s role in regulating blood sugar.

episodes.title: Urinary System, Part 1
episodes.description: Explore kidney anatomy and how nephrons filter waste, recover nutrients, and balance water and salts while producing urine.

episodes.title: Urinary System, Part 2
episodes.description: Explore how the urinary system regulates filtration, stores and excretes urine, and coordinates urination through the nervous system.

episodes.title: Reproductive System, Part 1 – Female Reproductive System
episodes.description: Explore how reproductive hormones regulate egg development, ovulation, and the ovarian and menstrual cycles.

episodes.title: Reproductive System, Part 2 – Male Reproductive System
episodes.description: Hank also explains how sperm mature, and how they leave the body on a tide of glandular secretions during ejaculation.

episodes.title: Reproductive System, Part 3 – Sex & Fertilization
episodes.description: Explore the human sexual response, fertilization, and how contraception can prevent pregnancy.

episodes.title: Reproductive System, Part 4 – Pregnancy & Development
episodes.description: Trace prenatal development from zygote to fetus, changes in the pregnant body, and the hormonal sequence leading to labor.

episodes.title: Lymphatic System
episodes.description: Hank describes the structure and function of your lymphatic system and how it supports your cardiovascular and immune systems.

episodes.title: Immune System, Part 1
episodes.description: Explore immune defenses, including physical barriers, phagocytes, natural killer cells, and inflammation.

episodes.title: Immune System, Part 2
episodes.description: In the penultimate episode of Crash Course Anatomy & Physiology, Hank explains your adaptive immune system.

episodes.title: Immune System, Part 3
episodes.description: Explore how T cells coordinate the cellular immune response and what happens when immune defenses cause autoimmune disease.
